words.def: reducing the money a company spends in order to save money or improve profit.
words.book: I understand the importance of cost-cutting.
uses: As part of our cost-cutting plan, we'll combine the PM visits for the Alex sites into one trip.
more cost-cutting?? so no overtime this month 😬
Cost-cutting alone won't fix this — we also need new maintenance contracts.
dont: We need to make cutting in the costs.

words.def: the 12-month period a company uses for its accounts and budgets.
words.book: I'd like to suggest that we set a specific target for the end of the fiscal year.
uses: Please send all pending invoices before the end of the fiscal year on 30 June.
is the solar project in this fiscal year's budget or next?
Our target is to renew 40 maintenance contracts by the end of the fiscal year.
goes: the end of the fiscal year
dont: At the end of the money year we close the accounts.
doo: We close the accounts at the end of the fiscal year.

words.def: how possible and practical it is to do something successfully.
words.book: We should consider the market demand and feasibility of this new product line.
uses: Before we quote, we need to check the feasibility of installing solar panels on the customer's roof.
did anyone do a feasibility check on the 3-phase UPS for that site?
Let's run a feasibility study before we commit to the data-centre project.
dont: We will study if this thing can happen or not.
doo: We'll look into the feasibility of this.

words.ar: يفحص ويدقّق كويس قبل ما يوافق
words.def: to check someone or something carefully before you accept or trust them.
words.book: We need to carefully vet any potential partners and make sure they align with our values and mission.
uses: All new battery suppliers must be vetted by Purchasing before we issue a PO.
has anyone vetted this subcontractor? never heard of them 🤔
We vet every installation partner for safety certificates and references.
dont: We must make a check on the supplier very well.
doo: We need to vet the supplier carefully.

words.def: to think again about something to decide whether you need to change it.
words.book: The group agreed to aim for a 5% increase in revenue, with a plan in place to reassess and adjust the target if necessary.
uses: We'll reassess the service schedule after the first three months of the contract.
prices went up again, we need to reassess the quote before sending it
If collections don't improve by Q3, we'll reassess our payment terms.
dont: We will evaluate again the situation.

words.def: to meet again after a break, usually to continue the same meeting.
words.book: Let's reconvene in ten minutes to continue our discussion.
uses: Let's reconvene on Thursday once we have the updated battery prices from the supplier.
We're out of time, so let's reconvene tomorrow to finalise the tender.
dont: We will return to meet again after the break.

pro: I am agree with you totally.
upgrade.why: ‎agree‎ فعل مش صفة، فمن غير ‎am‎؛ و‎I couldn't agree more‎ = موافق جدًا.

upgrade.plain: What do you mean? I don't understand anything.
upgrade.ar: قصدك إيه؟ أنا مش فاهم حاجة
pro: I have a question for clarification.
upgrade.why: اطلب التوضيح بأدب؛ و‎explain‎ مبتاخدش ‎me‎ على طول.

upgrade.plain: We must cut the employees to save money.
upgrade.ar: لازم نمشّي موظفين عشان نوفّر فلوس
pro: We must fire people to make saving.
We may need to reduce the workforce to cut costs.
upgrade.why: ‎reduce the workforce‎ أهدى وأكثر احترافية من ‎cut the employees‎.

upgrade.plain: Let's write this in the tasks to do it later.
upgrade.ar: خلينا نكتب دي في المهام ونعملها بعدين
pro: Let's write it in the to-do to make it after.
Let's put that on the action item list.
We add this to the jobs list.
upgrade.why: في الاجتماعات بنقول ‎action item list‎ للمهام المطلوبة بعد الاجتماع.

pro: All in favour, raise your hands.
Who is agree raise his hand.
upgrade.why: للتصويت الرسمي: ‎All in favour‎ وبعدها ‎raise your hands‎.

upgrade.plain: The target 10% is very big, we can't reach it.
upgrade.ar: تارجت ١٠٪ كبير أوي، مش هنقدر نوصله
pro: This target is too much big.
We can't reach it, it is impossible.
I'm not sure a 10% target is realistic in our current situation.
upgrade.why: اعترض بلطف بـ ‎I'm not sure … is realistic‎ بدل ما تقول مستحيل.
